d: Short, fluffy platinum white hair with blunt-cut bangs and a small side ponytail. Bright sky blue eyes with a youthful, wide-eyed expression on a face with the apparent age of a young adolescent. A slender build wearing a white oversized utility jacket with yellow accents over a white crop top and dark grey shorts, paired with dark grey knee-high socks and white-and-orange high-top sneakers. Accessories include a yellow-tinted pair of goggles perched on the head, a technical chest harness with a small camera, a white backpack, a small bandage on the right thigh, and a large, curved black-and-white mechanical anchor weapon.
